Category: Support
Questions: Can I call the eShop support team? What phone number is listed for eShop assistance? Which contact channels does the eShop help center list?
Answer: The eShop help center lists 0771701777 for calls and WhatsApp, and eShopjordan@orange.jo for email.

Category: Business information
Questions: What is Orange eShop? Can I shop online instead of visiting an Orange shop? What does the Orange online store do?
Answer: Orange eShop allows customers in Jordan to buy Orange offers and mobile devices online without visiting a physical shop.

Category: Payment and promo codes
Questions: How to apply a promo code? Where do I enter my discount code? How do I use a coupon at checkout? How can I apply my promotional code to an order? What should I do after entering a promo code?
Answer: -Enter the promo code in the checkout screen. -Make sure you click apply coupon.

Category: Support
Questions: Is there an online contact form? What information does the enquiry form ask for? How can I send an enquiry through the website?
Answer: The eShop Contact Us page has a form asking for your name, email address, and enquiry.
